- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:249-272 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The root hook lacks the redirect and file-descriptor handling present in the claimed changes, so redirect parsing and template-parity tests fail.
  WHY: The root hook’s parser treats `>` as punctuation instead of consuming redirect syntax, and the root hook is missing other changes that the parity test expects.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:268 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The template guard uses `segment[-1].isdigit()` to detect file descriptor prefixes, which treats Unicode digits such as `²` as file descriptors.
  WHY: `git push origin ²>/dev/null` can lose the push target because the non-ASCII digit is popped from the segment.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:259-281 | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The position-based source-text check can fail to pop a single-character file descriptor because `previous_token_end` and the slice’s exclusive end produce an empty slice.
  WHY: For `2>`, the fd-detection guard fails and the guard may look up branch `2` instead of the current branch.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:`_shell_segments_with_operators` | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The redirect check can remove an entire refspec token when it ends in an adjacent ASCII digit.
  WHY: For `git push origin feature2>/dev/null`, the parser drops `feature2`, so the guard checks the current branch instead of `feature2`.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:`_shell_segments_with_operators`, the fd-detection block (lines 266-273 in the diff) | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The parser only handles single-digit file descriptors, so multi-digit descriptors like `10>/dev/null` are not recognized.
  WHY: For `git push origin 10>/dev/null`, the guard checks branch `10` instead of the current branch, causing a false positive.
